## History

While driving home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spotted a nuisance Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field and, believing it to be her own cow Dolly, impulsively sold the stray to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. However, upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovered Dolly safely in the barnyard and realized she had accidentally sold Mr.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P42](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0042)_
